name: app-gamified-recipe-swipe-and-leaderboard-dark
title: Dark recipe app with a teal photo card, pill Save button and a coin-league leaderboard
whatItIs: Two dark phones: one with a rounded teal-glow card of a poke bowl, a yellow bubbly logo with XP chip and a big teal Save pill next to a dismiss button; and a Leaderboard with a pixel-art coin medal, 'Bronze League' text and ranked avatar rows with XP counts.
whatItMeans: Playful and rewarding; food swiping meets a game league.
techniques: Pair a huge food photo card with swipe buttons.
Use coin medals and 3D avatars for gamification.
Use one pink accent for active tabs.
Set bubbly display type for the logo.
bestFor: Food and habit apps with game loops

vocabulary.definition: A large card decided with save or dismiss.
A small counter of experience points.
A list line with position, avatar and score.
